in_marathi.name: Gunitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Weapon, Power, Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gunitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Guna’ meaning 'weapon' and ‘Tha’ meaning 'placed'. This name signifies power and victory, symbolizing a woman who is strong, fearless, and capable of overcoming any obstacle. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Durga, a form of the Divine Mother, is often depicted holding various weapons, symbolizing her power and strength.
